name: dev-team
description: A small developer team for one user story: a senior designs and builds the critical core, mediors build the work packages, a security reviewer checks the diff, and the main session leads the team with two human gates. Branch and commit only, with a track record, a command log, and checks. Needs dev-stack. Output in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).
